bayts.text: bless with a blessing that surpasses intellects and sets right the rational and the transmitted,
with a peace that grants us the Law (sharīʿa) with the Reality (ḥaqīqa), as a means
to God, the Book and the Messenger, that grants me in this world and the next the best request,
upon the Prophet and Messenger, the ladder, the Arab, the Hāshimite, the banner.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me nearness, and hear my word with a hearing of acceptance, and gather good for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), Knower (Al-ʿĀlim),
bless with a blessing that takes away heedlessness toward other than my heart, that prevents setting,
with a peace that lifts the veil and draws steadfastness and the gift,
upon him who has already come, forever, between me and whoever refused to worship.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me sound knowledge and righteous deeds that complete hope.
And gather the wishes for me by the day of ʿArafa, and by the right of those who fast on it grant me gnosis.
And spread over me the blessings of the sacred (months) and of all the months, and protect my sanctuary.
And build for me the impregnable fortress, guarding the Remembrance through me, whether I reflect or utter.
And grant me the affirmation of Oneness and the ḥadīth, and grant me exegesis and transmission (of ḥadīth).
And grant me excellence in the disciplines, O Giver of the manifest and the hidden.
And make the Truth manifest through my writing and the tongue, O You Who bestow triumph and fair things on me.
O Effacer of afflictions and turbidities, O Giver of neighbours after the abode.
Bless with a blessing and a peace by which You hear my gratitude and gather the wishes for me,
through it, upon the servant, the Messenger, the most beneficial, O You through whom my hand stretches toward You.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And illumine the months and seasons for me, as You granted me arrival.
And for me illumine every day and year, O You Who are exalted above sleep and slumber (Qurʾān 2:255).
And free me, with memory, from forgetting; You have bestowed on me the months and vision.
And free me, with reward, from reckoning, O You Who lead all of me with reliance (on You).
And make the soul good and make the heart good for me, and bring the wishes into being for me unto the Gardens.
O Sender-down, You granted me dwelling, and guarded for me the neighbours and the place
from everything unbefitting my side, O You Who are worthy of my praise and my gratitude.
Bless with a blessing that makes the lawful firm with me and bars misguidance from me,
with a peace that banishes evils and shows every misguidance its retreat,
upon the Prophet and Messenger, the most God-fearing, O You Who by his standing opened what was sealed (cf. Qurʾān 21:30).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make by his mighty standing my poem, O You Who protected me from what drives one to suppress anger,
with You, faith and Islām together, the finest excellence (iḥsān); and gather the wishes for me.
And with You make it treasures for me, O You Who bring increase and the hidden treasure.
And turn back, by the right of Your noble Countenance, O Giver of permanence and honour,
toward other than my person whoever has made for me with harm, and protect me from solecisms.
And preserve, for Your noble Countenance, my creed, word and deed from the people of censure.
And make, for Your noble Countenance, all of me Your highest good pleasure, multiplying my little for me.
O Allah, O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), O All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), O You through Whom ruin has not reached me,
bless with a blessing that repels every evil toward a direction other than mine and raises my striving,
with a peace that guards my side from the harm of the claw and the harm of the fang,
upon him who granted me the Book and turned reproach toward others than me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
